# `executive_disclosure_transactions`

**Executive disclosure securities transactions**

Executive disclosure securities transaction observations from OGE Form 278e Part 7 (and future qualified Form 278-T periodic transaction reports) for an explicitly selected public filing cohort.

**Coverage.** Not a range. Explicitly selected publicly posted OGE Form 278e packages from official White House archives and public OGE collections, excluding Form 201 agency-gated filings. Deterministic extraction covers qualified Form 278e Part 7 transactions; Form 278-T and scanned or amended packages remain lookup-only until visually qualified. No complete executive, amendment, historical or personal-profile coverage. See docs/executive-disclosures.md. *(measured 2026-11-28)*

- **Parquet file:** `executive_disclosure_transactions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cohort_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of the explicitly declared report cohort, with omissions stated in coverage_note. |
| `filing_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reviewed report identity within the cohort; join to executive_disclosure_filings on filing_id. |
| `transaction_id` | `VARCHAR` | Page-scoped transaction identity ({filing_id}:{source_sha256}:{section_code}:p{page}:{row_number_raw}); handles per-page row-number resets without collision. |
| `form_type` | `VARCHAR` | Source OGE form identifier (278e for Part 7 transactions, or 278-T for periodic transaction reports). |
| `section` | `VARCHAR` | Qualified OGE transaction section heading (such as Part 7: Transactions). |
| `section_code` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical transaction section code (such as part7 or form278t). |
| `row_number_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Native source row label on the page, preserving punctuation. |
| `description_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal source Description cell, including ownership prefixes and ticker text; no security identifier is invented. |
| `ownership_label` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Self, Spouse or Joint prefix when stated in Description; NULL when unstated. |
| `transaction_type_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal printed transaction type (such as purchase, sale, or exchange). |
| `transaction_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal printed transaction date cell retained verbatim from the PDF. |
| `transaction_date_status` | `VARCHAR` | Classification of transaction_date_raw as parsed, blank, or unparsed. |
| `notification_over_30_days_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Form 278-T Notification Received Over 30 Days Ago cell; NULL on Form 278e Part 7 rows where the column does not exist. |
| `amount_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Literal printed transaction amount bracket or dollar string; not an exact cash value unless amount_status is exact_amount. |
| `amount_status` | `VARCHAR` | Classification of amount_raw as range, below_threshold, over_threshold, exact_amount, blank, or unrecognized. |
| `currency` | `VARCHAR` | USD when amount_status is a recognized USD bracket or exact amount; NULL otherwise. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official publicly posted PDF URL, retained independently of extracted rows. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Exact original PDF digest; reopen through CentralRawArchiveStore and verify before replay. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | One-based original PDF page fragment; append to source_url to inspect the original. |
| `parser_revision` | `VARCHAR` | Source-specific interpretation rule revision; retained with backend version for replay. |
| `backend_version` | `VARCHAR` | Installed PyMuPDF table-reader version used for this observation. |
| `raw_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered source table cells including blanks and original text. |
| `cell_boxes_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original table cell coordinates for bounded visual reconciliation. |
| `page` | `BIGINT` | One-based page in the exact original PDF, including any prefixed amendment pages. |
| `amount_lower` | `BIGINT` | USD lower bound when amount_status is range, below_threshold (0), or over_threshold (exclusive lower bound); NULL otherwise. |
| `amount_upper` | `BIGINT` | Inclusive USD upper bound when amount_status is range or below_threshold; NULL for over_threshold, exact_amount, blank, or unrecognized. |
| `transaction_date` | `DATE` | Parsed printed transaction calendar date when transaction_date_status is parsed; NULL otherwise. |
